mapper.select: SELECT a.auth_cd AS authrt_cd, /* 권한 코드 */ a.auth_nm AS authrt_nm, /* 권한 명 */ (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT usr_id) FROM cdm_own.usr WHERE auth_cd = a.auth_cd) AS authrt_user_cnt, /* 권한사용자수 */ a.auth_dvcd AS authrt_se /* 권한 구분 */ FROM cdm_own.auth a WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' /* 사용 여부 */ ORDER BY a.sort_seq

SELECT (CASE WHEN b.menu_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS save_se_yn, /* 저장구분YN */ a.menu_id, /* 메뉴 ID */ a.menu_nm, /* 메뉴 명 */ #{authrtCd} AS authrt_cd, /* 권한 코드 */ a.url_addr, /* URL 주소 */ a.npag_yn, /* 새창 여부 */ a.anct_menu_id AS up_menu_id, /* 상위 메뉴 ID */ (SELECT s.menu_nm FROM cdm_own.menu s WHERE s.menu_id = a.anct_menu_id) AS up_menu_id_nm, /* 상위 메뉴 명 */ a.sort_seq AS sort_sn /* 정렬 일련번호 */ FROM cdm_own.menu a LEFT JOIN cdm_own.menu_auth b ON a.menu_id = b.menu_id AND b.auth_cd = #{authrtCd} WHERE 1=1 AND COALESCE(a.menu_use_yn, 'Y') != 'N'
AND (a.menu_id LIKE '%' || #{menuIdOrNm} || '%' OR a.menu_nm LIKE '%' || #{menuIdOrNm} || '%') /* 메뉴 ID 또는 명 */
ORDER BY a.menu_id, a.sort_seq
